description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling the LoggingExpired command within a messaging persistence framework. It extends an abstract strategy class, specifies the associated command type, and determines the connection action to disable logging.

classes.name: LoggingExpiredStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles LoggingExpired commands by providing the specific connection action to disable logging.
